content:
Texas Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico jumped on a geographical typo by his Donald Trump-endorsed Republican rival, Ken Paxton.

Paxton, the Texas attorney general, thanked supporters who had attended his campaign event in Lubbock over the weekend, in a post on X.

“This campaign continues to grow every day,” he claimed.

Paxton then teased his next event: “Next stop: Cyprus with the great @TedCruz. We will keep Texas, Texas.”

But Paxton actually meant he’d be rallying with Sen. Ted Cruz (R-Texas) in Cypress, near Houston, and not Cyprus, the Mediterranean island nation.

But Talarico didn’t let the mistake slide.

“It’s Cypress, not ‘Cyprus,’” he noted.

“But for all the time you spend on luxury vacations in Europe, it’s no surprise you don’t know Texas,” Talarico added, swiping at controversies surrounding Paxton’s overseas travel.
